dog.description_text:
Pop Up Promo! ACC is over capacity, so I'm currently living in a pop up crate. My adoption fee is waived, and my adoption comes with a $50 Chewy gift card.

Meet Pinky!

Pinky is a bouncy, wiggly girl with a whole lot of personality packed into one adorable package! Found as a stray, she was eager to say hello during her assessment and readily approached her handlers, although she had a hard time settling down and was ready to keep the party going. She's got plenty of pep in her step and may just be the perfect little Pinky for someone looking for an active companion!

My Ideal Home

Pinky would love an active home that can give her plenty of exercise, enrichment, and positive training. Long walks, fun activities, and puzzle toys can help keep her busy while she works on her impulse control. With the right guidance, this energetic girl can turn all that excitement into some pretty pink-tastic progress!

Good with Other Pets?

Pinky's history with other animals is unknown. Any future introductions should be slow, careful, and managed by her new family once she's had time to settle in.

Good with Kids?

Pinky would do best in a home without young children under 5. She was persistently jumping on handlers during her assessment, so older children who can give her space and follow guidance may be a better fit.

Things to Know

Pinky has lots of enthusiasm and is still learning that she doesn't need to jump up to get attention. Her new family should use force-free, reward-based training to reinforce behaviors like sit, stay, down, and leave it. She'll need plenty of exercise and enrichment to help her channel all that energy, and with some patience and consistency, this Pinky could be pretty in pink and ready to shine!
